content.title: ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Episode 1 – release date, schedule, how to watch
content.text: "Invincible" returns to Prime Video this week, and Season 4 kicks off with three new episodes on March 18 at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET.This new season will follow Mark as he fights to protect the people he loves, setting him on course to face a threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever.The animated series features voice performances from Steven Yeun, Sandra Oh, and J.K. Simmons, along with additional cast members Gillian Jacobs, Seth Rogen, Walton Goggins, Lee Pace, Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Jason Mantzoukas, Zazie Beetz, Grey DeLisle, Zachary Quinto, Chris Diamantopoulos, Ross Marquand, Khary Payton, Andrew Rannells, Kevin Michael Richardson, Ben Schwartz, Clancy Brown, Jay Pharoah, Mark Hamill, Matthew Rhys, Danai Gurira, and Melise.Following this week's three-episode premiere, "Invincible" will release new episodes weekly through April 22.Bulletproof (Jay Pharoah), Robot (Zachary Quinto), Monster Girl (Kevin Michael Richardson), Brit (Jonathan Banks), Shapesmith (Ben Schwartz), and Bla... | Courtesy of Prime'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 1 Release Date"Invincible" Season 4 Episode 1 will be available to stream on Prime Video on March 18, 2026.New episodes of "Invincible" Season 4 premiere on Prime Video each Wednesday through April 22, 2026.'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 1 – How to Watch"Invincible" Season 4 Episode 1 lands at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on Prime Video.A Prime Video subscription is required to watch "Invincible" Season 4. Prime Video costs $14.99 per month or $139 annually when included with an Amazon Prime membership, or you can subscribe to the streaming service alone for $8.99 per month.What Time Does 'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 1 Come Out?"Invincible" Season 4 Episode 1 will be available on Prime Video from 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET.With the early streaming release in the US, the debut time in other time zones will differ. Here is when "Invincible" Season 4 will air in different time zones:March 18BRT: 4:00 amBST: 8:00 amCEST: 9:00 amIST: 12:30 pmJST: 4:00 pmAET: 5:00 pmNZDT: 7:00 pmWill All Episodes of 'Invincible' Season 4 Land at Once?No. Season 4 of "Invincible" will launch with three episodes on March 18, followed by new episodes weekly through April 22.'Invincible' Season 4 Release ScheduleEpisode 1: March 18Episode 2: March 18Episode 3: March 18Episode 4: March 25Episode 5: April 1Episode 6: April 8Episode 7: April 15Episode 8: April 22'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 1 RuntimeThere is no confirmed runtime for "Invincible" Season 4 Episode 1 yet. Previous episodes in previous seasons have been approximately 49 minutes long.What Will Happen in 'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 1?The plot details for Episode 1 of "Invincible" Season 4 read:Mark battles enemies new and old in his fight to keep Earth safe.(as per IMDb)The Season 4 synopsis, as per Prime Video reads, "While the world recovers from catastrophe, a changed Mark fights to protect his home and the people he loves, setting him on a collision course with a threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever."
